curl[^|]*\|\s*(sudo\s+)?(bash|sh)\b	remote script piped directly into a shell — fetch, verify, then execute instead
wget[^|]*\|\s*(sudo\s+)?(bash|sh)\b	remote script piped directly into a shell — fetch, verify, then execute instead
chmod\s+(-R\s+)?0?777\b	world-writable permissions
chmod\s+(-R\s+)?a\+w\b	world-writable permissions
bash\s+<\(\s*(curl|wget)	remote script run via process substitution — fetch, verify, then execute instead
sh\s+-c\s+"\$\((curl|wget|fetch)	remote script run via command substitution — fetch, verify, then execute instead
(curl|wget)[^|]*\|\s*env\b[^|]*\b(ba)?sh\b	remote script piped into a shell via env — fetch, verify, then execute instead
--allow-unsigned-rpm	package signature check disabled
--nogpgcheck	package signature check disabled
--gpg-auto-import-keys	repository signing keys trusted without verification
curl\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*k\b|--insecure)	TLS certificate verification disabled
StrictHostKeyChecking[= ]+no	SSH host key verification disabled
